scope: Maintained Canic blob API, emitted endpoints, storage lifecycle, operator commands and diagnostics. Behavior preservation with required safety corrections; not source/API compatibility.
evidence_semantics: Source test references identify reviewed tests or assertion helpers, not tests executed here. Replacement evidence records bounded executed coverage and its remaining gaps; a nonempty list is not full capability qualification. Empty replacement_evidence means no replacement qualification has been retained. This inventory is not an executable release gate.

replacement_evidence.coverage: Raw content SHA-256; distinct provider root type; canonical text and binary root conversion; typed malformed-input errors.
replacement_evidence.remaining: Provider tree/checkpoint computation, endpoint integration and verified upload/read journey.

replacement_evidence.coverage: Incremental raw-content digest and exact-length verification; ordered byte offsets; unchanged state after chunk rejection; corruption/truncation errors; constant-size hash state.
replacement_evidence.remaining: Trusted expected-digest provenance, provider tree/chunk proofs, persisted checkpoints and actual upload/read workflow.

replacement_evidence.coverage: Bounded streaming raw-content/provider-tree computation and comparison for nonempty content; root-bound ordered chunk manifests verify leaves independently by exact index/length. Independent client vectors cover chunk edges, uneven trees, metadata, reverse-order verification, corrupted/reordered manifests and retry after corruption. No completion state changes on reads.
replacement_evidence.remaining: Empty-provider-object contract, trusted root/length/tenant provenance, HTTP/serving policy, upload wire tree/proofs/certificates, persisted checkpoints and real upload/read journeys. Matching roots or leaves do not establish provider completion.

replacement_evidence.coverage: Bounded in-memory unique-position coverage over a validated manifest. Independent client vectors show out-of-order delivery, missing-position recovery, equal hashes at distinct indices, retry without double credit and exact byte accounting. Corrupt/invalid input never advances coverage; even prior successes are checked again. The ordered variant checks leaves before advancing a raw-content hash, rejects skips/replays without mutation and returns both identities only after complete length and the independent raw digest match. Client vectors exercise corrupt retries at each position; a conflicting raw digest rejects despite valid manifest bytes. Missing-chunk enumeration supplies exact local byte ranges under independent scan/result budgets, progresses through empty filtered pages, and observes intervening verification without reserving or marking ranges. Client-vector tests cover budget combinations and partial final chunks.
replacement_evidence.remaining: Trusted root/length/digest/tenant provenance, destination storage and write coordination, persisted resume checkpoints and actual provider/service read completion. Unordered coverage alone does not verify a whole-file raw digest. Local byte ranges do not establish provider HTTP range support or in-flight read reservations.

replacement_evidence.coverage: Actual Wasm execution of pinned full-leaf, partial-final-leaf and Unicode metadata vectors; reverse-order coverage, duplicate accounting, missing-page continuation, corrupt ordered retries, replay rejection and typed wrong-digest/truncated failures. A broad local instruction budget covers each valid ordered append.
replacement_evidence.remaining: Production input handling and throughput, trusted consumer identities, destination writes, persistent resume, both adapters and actual provider/service journeys. Fixed fixture data and instruction intervals do not qualify those boundaries.
